What improved

The existing permissions and submission behavior remain unchanged. The updates focus on hierarchy, clarity, touch targets, and responsive flow.

  • Consistent customer-facing Ticket language throughout the journey.
  • Clearer customer and staff account choices with descriptive paths.
  • Simplified mobile progress with richer desktop status labels.
  • Examples, counters, and explicit optional-field guidance.
  • Distinct photo, file-picker, drag, and paste entry points.
  • Visible upload limits and clearer validation messages.
  • Larger touch targets and a full-screen mobile annotation space.
  • Cleaner review summary before a customer submits a Ticket.
